items.title: Arabic Palace
items.creator: Diluvian
items.description:
An incredible palace made in the middle of the desert oasis and with several challenges for you to explore in it!

+ Super detailed cave for you to collect resources!
+ Loot chests!

items.title: The Ultimate Teens
items.creator: Builders Horizon
items.description:
The Ultimate Teens have landed! School roleplay, fashion trends, and a whole lot of teenage social media!

+ 12 Ultimate teen skins!
+ Roleplay as teenagers at school!
+ Perfect for roleplay maps and more!
+ Be yourself but the ultimate teens!
+ By Architects Edge & Builders Horizon

items.title: Mega Lucky Block Skyblock
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Mega lucky blocks on giant islands! Survive in a massive skyblock world where you can test your luck and hope for great outcomes!

items.title: Rainbow Sam and Anna
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Discover the legend of Rainbow Sam & Anna with this mysterious pack!
Become a powerful, colorful legend and battle it out with your friends! 

+ 12 Rainbow Sam & Anna Skins
+ 2 free skins!
+ Includes rainbow, boss, and corrupted skins!

items.title: RPG Fantasy Creatures
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Unique skins tailored for RPG fantasy experience, including orcs, elves, gnomes and more fantasy creatures. Perfect fit for roleplay with magic and swords.

+ Fantasy experience
+ RPG ready
+ 16 unique skins

items.title: Noob Pro God
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Noobs vs pros vs gods! Who will win!? Aren't you a noob? Gather up with friends and prove that you are worthy of the god title!

+ 15 Unique skins
+ Adorable noobs

items.title: Blue Sweaters
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Is your favorite color blue? Show your pride by wearing a blue sweater!

- 10 blue sweater themed teen skins!
- By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Creepers!
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
These Creepers have transformed into diverse elemental creepers!
Battle it out with your friends to find the strongest creeper!

+ 10 HD Skins
+ 1 free HD skin
+ Includes fire, water, and earth creepers!

items.title: Masked Anime
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Mask ON! Welcome to this amazing anime universe where everything is possible! Meet fancy anime teens who are hiding their personalities. Get to know their free true self and become best friends! You will be the change who will free these teens. Teach them to show their inner beauty!

+ 1 free skin 
+ 12 anime-themed skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Anime Mash-up
items.creator: Everbloom Games
items.description:
Explore a massive anime city! Featuring a giant robot boss battle, detailed interiors, secrets to find, games to play, and more! Get to know the people, or use the texture pack in your own worlds! 
* New vehicles, new mobs, so much new content!
* Massive city with complete interiors for roleplay!
* Full anime texture pack you can use in your own worlds!

items.title: Spring Vikings
items.creator: The Rage Craft Room
items.description: These warrior skins have emerged from their winter slumber and are ready for battle, are you? In like a lion! Claim your next victory with these 8 spring-inspired Viking skins.

items.title: Pastel Ponies
items.creator: The Rage Craft Room
items.description: What a perfect day for these 9 pastel ponies! With names like Rainbow, Sunset, Galaxy, Sprinkles, Queen and colors to match, these horse skins will brighten up any adventure.

items.title: Skins of the Month - March
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Spring is here yet again and we're bringing you these 14 March-inspired skins to celebrate! You'll find rainbows, lucky dogs, butterflies, basketball players, and your favorite spring treats. Get ready to leap into the new season. Be sure to bring this springtime pack along for the ride!

items.title: Streamer Simulator
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Start from small beginnings streaming to 0 viewers in your Mom's basement.
Then grow a GIANT audience and live on an island mansion - this is Streamer Simulator!

+ Stream 5 custom mini-games to gain subscribers and coins!
+ Random bonus events!
+ Tons of custom streaming equipment!
+ Customize your streaming setup!
+ 2 free skins included!
+ And more!

items.title: Sakura Village
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Nestled among an ocean of pink sakura petals lies an old Japanese village of which some say a clan of Ninjas resides there. Start your Japanese adventure today with Sakura Village!

- Stunning village
- By RareLoot

items.title: Farmer Teens
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
It's time to start your adventure as the new farmer in the village. Choose any of these skins for your next farming adventure to help the other villagers, harvest, and plant crops! 

+ 10 HD skins included

items.title: Slimed
items.creator: Dragnoz
items.description:
The slime invasion started slowly without any resistance and before the world knew it everyone was walking around with green goo covering their clothes and hair. 

- 1 free slimed skin

items.title: Shadow Stalkers
items.creator: Dragnoz
items.description: They hide in the shadows, their motives unknown. Are they a force for evil or the heroes of the day? Grab a skin and choose your fate for only you can decide what awaits.

items.title: Dinosaur Arena
items.creator: Cyclone
items.description:
You are the newest competitor in the dinosaur arena.
Prove your strength in ferocious battles, together with and against the wildest beasts the past has to offer.

+ 18 dinosaurs to battle
+ 30+ arena battles
+ 10 different classes

items.title: Techno Rangers Skin Pack
items.creator: Ninja Squirrel Gaming
items.description:
Put on a technopunk ranger skin, unleash your inner warrior and roleplay a battle against the ferocious robot monsters with your friends! Make your choice between the ranger skins or the monsters. These 13 Techno Ranger skins are perfect for any sci-fi roleplays!

-Includes robots, mechs and robotic monsters!
- By Ninja Squirrel Gaming

items.title: Racecar Drivers
items.creator: Cleverlike
items.description: Satisfy your need for speed with this pack of racecar drivers with matching pit crew. Whether you play to win or play for fun, this pack has a skin that is perfect for you. Includes 2 free matching skins.

items.title: Wedding Joy
items.creator: Cleverlike
items.description: Congratulations! Your big day has arrived and now you can dress to match your style! These skins are the perfect way to dress as you begin the next chapter of your adventures with your family and friends. Includes two free bride skins.

items.title: Y2K Fashion
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Time to revive old fashion! Its the beginning of the 21st century, so try the latest trends of that time, while showing off your unique style. Jump back in time with these throwback skins and try the old school fashion once again! Steal the spotlight and rock your free world with these vibrant skins. 

+ 1 free skin 
+ 12 old school skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Neko Anime Teens
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
The cutest cats are back in the city! This group of felines travel around watching anime and playing games together while living their best life in Minecraft. Rock out to some K-Pop or find your inner cat with all your favorite Neko friends!

+ 12 neko teen skins 
+ 1 free skin
+ By Ready, Set, Block!
